Emitter silent.name: Emitter silent
Emitter silent.description: No grokbot.emitter.ok datapoints for 2 hours 15 minutes (hourly emitter around :07; one missed run plus slack).

rules.parameterizedBody: No grokbot.emitter.ok points for 2 hours 15 minutes, so the hourly emit routine has stopped or its export failed. Fix: run bin/run_emit.sh and read the one-line summary; confirm the routine is enabled and the OpenTelemetry SDK is installed.

Box disk high.name: Box disk high
Box disk high.description: Root (or GROKBOT_DISK_PATH) disk used percent stayed above 85 for 1 hour 15 minutes.

rules.parameterizedBody: Box disk is {{inputs.signal.value}}% (>85%). Fix: find large rebuildable caches and clear them; do not delete source data.

Box memory high.name: Box memory high
Box memory high.description: Memory used percent stayed above 90 for 1 hour 15 minutes.

rules.parameterizedBody: Box memory is {{inputs.signal.value}}% (>90%). Fix: look for runaway processes (for example leftover browsers or pollers).

HA down.name: HA down
HA down.description: Home Assistant reachability (grokbot.home.ha.up) stayed at 0 for 1 hour 15 minutes. A down reading is omitted when the status file is older than 30 minutes, so a stale file does not fire this detector.

rules.parameterizedBody: Home Assistant reports down for 2 hourly samples. Fix: rerun the home-status refresh; this detector is monitoring only and never sends Home Assistant commands. If grokbot.home.status.age_minutes is also high, refresh the status file first — a stale file is not treated as down.

UniFi watchdog failing.name: UniFi watchdog failing
UniFi watchdog failing.description: Network extras-poller watchdog (grokbot.home.unifi.watchdog_ok) stayed at 0 for 1 hour 15 minutes.

rules.parameterizedBody: The network extras-poller watchdog is not ok. Fix: check the watchdog status file and restart the loop if it has stopped.

Backup failed or stale.name: Backup failed or stale
Backup failed or stale.description: Backup age (grokbot.backup.age_hours) stayed above 25 hours for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Backup failed or stale.programText:
age = data('grokbot.backup.age_hours').publish('signal')
detect(when(age > 25, lasting='1h15m')).publish('Backup failed or stale')

rules.parameterizedSubject: Grok Bot backup failed or stale
rules.parameterizedBody: The nightly backup failed or is older than 25h. Fix: read the newest backup log and rerun the backup routine.

Email sync stale.name: Email sync stale
Email sync stale.description: Email sync age exceeded 9 hours for 1 hour 15 minutes.

rules.parameterizedBody: Email sync is older than 9h. Fix: rerun the email refresh routine; transient mailbox errors usually clear on retry.

Birds sync stale.name: Birds sync stale
Birds sync stale.description: Bird-detection sync stayed stale for two hourly samples.

rules.parameterizedBody: Bird-detection sync is older than 2h for 2 samples. Fix: rerun the hourly sync and check that its environment is intact.

Pipeline overdue.name: Pipeline overdue
Pipeline overdue.description: A scheduled pipeline (calendar, finance, home, jobs, trader heartbeat, trading status sync) has missed its schedule: hours since last success exceed the schedule budget (latest run that should have finished + allowance) for 2 hourly samples. Email, birds and backup have their own detectors.
Pipeline overdue.programText:
r = data('grokbot.pipeline.age_ratio', filter=filter('pipeline', 'calendar', 'finance', 'home', 'jobs', 'trader', 'ls_trading'))
detect(when(r >= 1, lasting='1h15m')).publish('Pipeline overdue')

rules.parameterizedBody: {{dimensions.pipeline}} is overdue ({{inputs.r.value}}x its schedule budget). See the Bot Ops dashboard runbook: calendar, finance, home, jobs, trader, and ls_trading each have a refresh step.

Emitter collector failing.name: Emitter collector failing
Emitter collector failing.description: One emit.py collector raised an error on 2 consecutive hourly runs (its source file is missing or malformed). Other collectors keep reporting.
Emitter collector failing.programText:
c = data('grokbot.collector.ok')
detect(when(c < 1, lasting='1h15m')).publish('Emitter collector failing')

rules.parameterizedBody: Collector {{dimensions.collector}} failed on consecutive emits. Fix: run python3 bin/emit.py --dry-run and look at sources_fail; the error type is on the collector span in APM (service grokbot-emitter).
